affected.note: Backup of the water and sewerage bureau's accounting system: up to 19,828 records of creditors such as business partners, and up to 6,151 bank account records. The file was password protected and could only be restored by the system maintenance vendor; no leak was confirmed.

summary.en: Toyohashi City in Aichi Prefecture lost a USB memory stick holding a backup of its water and sewerage bureau accounting system while it was being handed to or returned from an off-site storage contractor. It contained up to 19,828 records of names, addresses and phone numbers and up to 6,151 bank account records.
summary.ja: 愛知県豊橋市は、上下水道局の公営企業会計システムのバックアップデータを保存したUSBメモリを、外部保管業者との受け渡しの過程で紛失したと公表した。氏名、住所、電話番号など最大1万9,828件と、口座情報最大6,151件が記録されていた。

sources.title: データの受け渡し過程でバックアップデータ紛失 - 豊橋市
大規模災害に備えバックアップデータを記録したUSBメモリを紛失（豊橋市）
